mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report (report_user_id, target_type, target_id, reason, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) VALUES (#{reportUserId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.sql: r.id, r.report_user_id, u.name AS report_user_name, r.target_type, r.target_id, r.reason, r.status, r.create_time
r.id, r.target_type, r.target_id, r.reason, r.status, r.create_time

r.id, r.report_user_id, u.name AS report_user_name, u.student_no AS report_user_student_no, u.phone AS report_user_phone, r.target_type, r.target_id, case r.target_type when 1 then g.title when 2 then tu.name when 3 then left(cm.content, 100) else null end AS target_name, tu.student_no AS target_user_student_no, tu.phone AS target_user_phone, tu.role AS target_user_role, tu.status AS target_user_status, tu.campus AS target_user_campus, tu.intro AS target_user_intro, g.title AS goods_title, g.price AS goods_price, g.status AS goods_status, case g.status when 0 then '草稿' when 1 then '待审核' when 2 then '已驳回' when 3 then '在售' when 4 then '锁定' when 5 then '已售出' when 6 then '已下架' else null end AS goods_status_desc, c.name AS goods_category_name, g.location AS goods_location, g.detail AS goods_detail, g.cover AS goods_cover, g.seller_id AS goods_seller_id, gu.name AS goods_seller_name, gu.student_no AS goods_seller_student_no, gu.phone AS goods_seller_phone, gu.campus AS goods_seller_campus, r.reason, r.status, r.handle_admin_id, a.name AS handle_admin_name, r.handle_result, r.handle_time, r.create_time

r.id, r.target_type, r.target_id, case r.target_type when 1 then g.title when 2 then tu.name when 3 then left(cm.content, 100) else null end AS target_name, tu.role AS target_user_role, tu.status AS target_user_status, tu.campus AS target_user_campus, tu.intro AS target_user_intro, g.title AS goods_title, g.price AS goods_price, g.status AS goods_status, case g.status when 0 then '草稿' when 1 then '待审核' when 2 then '已驳回' when 3 then '在售' when 4 then '锁定' when 5 then '已售出' when 6 then '已下架' else null end AS goods_status_desc, c.name AS goods_category_name, g.location AS goods_location, g.detail AS goods_detail, g.cover AS goods_cover, g.seller_id AS goods_seller_id, gu.name AS goods_seller_name, gu.campus AS goods_seller_campus, r.reason, r.status, a.name AS handle_admin_name, r.handle_result, r.handle_time, r.create_time

FROM report r LEFT JOIN `user` u ON r.report_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN admin a ON r.handle_admin_id = a.id LEFT JOIN goods g ON r.target_type = 1 AND r.target_id = g.id LEFT JOIN category c ON g.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN `user` gu ON g.seller_id = gu.id LEFT JOIN `user` tu ON r.target_type = 2 AND r.target_id = tu.id LEFT JOIN chatmessage cm ON r.target_type = 3 AND r.target_id = cm.id
mapper.update: UPDATE report SET status = #{status}, handle_admin_id = #{handleAdminId}, handle_result = #{handleResult}, handle_time = #{handleTime}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_user = #{updateUser} WHERE id = #{id}
